purpose: Prospectively frozen CPU-only retrieval evaluation of the framework lexical ranker, not live API execution or the full ToolRet leaderboard.

queries.selection: all101queries in the official API-Bank subset, sorted by ID

corpus.selection: entire official web corpus37292tools, sorted by ID; no label-based candidate filtering

query_text: original query only; never use instruction or labels as ranker input
variants: framework field BM25: name twice + description + parameters
licenses: Dataset card has no license field; raw data is downloaded into private experiment storage and not redistributed in this repository. Publish only code, source revisions, hashes and aggregate/ID-based results.
retuning: Keep initial results including losses. Do not tune on these101labels and rerun for a better score.
